text: At its meeting held November 9, 10, and 12, 2021, City Council appointed the following two members to the board for a term of office from November 13, 2021 to November 10, 2025, and until successors are appointed: - Sharleen Ahmed - Howard Lichtman As part of this process, Paula Oliveria's term of office on the board came to an end effective November 12, 2021.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the item for information.
